title: fix: remove a warning about insights that is not relevant anymore
body:
<!--

**Summary**

This PR removes a warning about insights that is not relevant anymore.
The warning message was useful when user added `search-insights` but forgot to pass to `insightsClient` prop to `instantsearch()` call, but now that we don't encourage that prop anymore in favor of insights middleware, this warning message misleads those who use insights middleware.
